invariants.rationale: It is reasonable to expect that a method returning a HoodieWriteMetadata object does not return null, and this invariant appears in multiple drafts.
The method contract guarantees that result is of type HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>>, so this invariant is implied by the signature and appears across drafts.
The method likely requires a non-null collection of records to perform an insert overwrite, so it is a reasonable and cross-draft invariant.
